properties.title: Introduction to Our Company and Our Booth (Asia Air Survey)
properties.description:
This presentation will introduce Asia Air Survey's work in remote sensing, geospatial analysis, and consulting, with a focus on disaster risk reduction, infrastructure management, environmental conservation, and sustainable development. Through selected case studies and project experience from Japan and overseas, we will showcase how aerial surveying, LiDAR, satellite imagery, UAVs, AI, GIS, and digital twin technologies are applied to real-world challenges. Our booth will feature examples of these technologies and solutions, demonstrating how an integrated geospatial approach can support better planning, decision-making, and long-term resilience.

Asia Air Survey (AAS) is a leading geospatial engineering company with more than 70 years of experience in remote sensing, mapping, geospatial analysis, and consulting. Leveraging a wide range of sensing platforms, including aircraft, LiDAR, satellites, UAVs, mobile mapping systems, GIS, 3D geospatial modeling, and advanced digital technologies, we provide integrated services covering geospatial data acquisition, analysis, visualization, and decision support.
Our mission is to connect society through geospatial technologies and contribute to a safer, more resilient, and sustainable future. We support public and private sector clients, as well as international development partners, in addressing complex challenges related to disaster risk reduction, infrastructure management, environmental conservation, renewable energy, urban development, and digital transformation. By combining advanced remote sensing technologies with engineering and consulting expertise, we transform geospatial data into actionable insights that support informed decision-making and long-term sustainability.
Our booth will feature selected case studies and project experience from Japan and international development projects, demonstrating how aerial surveying, LiDAR, satellite imagery, UAVs, AI, digital twin technologies, and solutions such as Red Relief Image Maps (RRIM®) and GIS-based platforms have been applied to real-world challenges. These examples highlight how our integrated approach, from sensing and analysis to planning and consulting, helps create value for communities, governments, infrastructure owners, and businesses while contributing to more resilient and sustainable societies.
